name: STANDEA
description:
Designed for a client in the United States, STANDEA combines “Stance” and “Idea” — an app where people share their opinions and respond with Agree or Disagree.
The logo brings these two opposing reactions together in a single mark, with the letter S formed between them.
Its contrasting red and blue shapes express different viewpoints, creating a unified identity built around conversation and the exchange of ideas.
